_comment: Frame table for the t-59 office sample, round 21 (light-direction fix + palette stability). Every region below is a direct pixel crop from cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg (THE LAW, t-54, 2026-08-16 amendment) -- cleaned (JPEG-ringing despeckle + a SHARED 40-color median-cut palette across all 5 character frames, no per-frame drift) and scaled 3x nearest-neighbor. No pixel in atlas.png was hand-drawn.

sourceSheets.typing: cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg, row 2 ("AGENT TYPING LOOP"), native grid cells at column index 1,2,3 (0-based) of an 8x3 176x256 grid, y-trimmed to 321-512 (drops a bleeding leg/foot fragment from the walk row above -- the sheet's own row-spacing artifact, not introduced by the crop)
sourceSheets.idle: cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg, THE SAME ROW as typing (row 2, same 8x3 grid, same y-trim 321-512) -- column index 0 (the character standing before it sits down) and column index 7 (standing again after, with the desk's edge visible at frame-left). Round 21 change: round 20 sourced idle from a DIFFERENT sheet (sheet-agent-anims-b.jpg) with a different light register, which is what produced round 20's flagged light-direction seam. Pulling idle from the SAME row as typing instead means idle and typing now share one continuous light source by construction, not by after-the-fact color-matching.
sourceSheets.wallmon: cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg, the wall-mounted terminal prop centered above the row boundary (native crop x490-635,y0-90) -- same sheet as the character, so same light register

droppedThisRound.lamp: round 20 composited a floor lamp cropped from sheet-agent-anims-b.jpg row 3 (a back-facing loop with its own near-black-to-warm-amber lighting) next to the character crop's cooler cyan register. The critic's round-20 pass named this the mechanical-floor violation (t-54: 'one consistent light direction per scene', an automatic send-back regardless of craft quality) -- the lamp was the actual cross-sheet mismatch, not the wallmon. Dropped entirely rather than re-matched, since no lamp prop sharing the character's own row/light source was found in the current sheet set.
